name: Roth.mem_support_taylor_iff
signature:
private lemma mem_support_taylor_iff {P : MvPolynomial σ ℝ} {α : σ → ℝ} {d : σ →₀ ℕ} :
    d ∈ (taylor α P).support ↔ eval α (hasseDeriv d P) ≠ 0
what: A Taylor coefficient is supported exactly when the corresponding Hasse derivative evaluates nonzero at the center.
how: Combines mem_support_iff with the project coeff_taylor identity.
hypotheses: A real polynomial and point; no finiteness of the variable type.
